description.en: French company identifier, nine digits in groups of three. The lookahead is what makes it composable: a SIRET is a SIREN followed by five more digits, and without it the shorter SIREN wins the shared start and shreds every SIRET. Declare fr-siret first all the same, so an establishment number is read as one.

match.text: Le numéro SIREN 732 829 320 permet de retrouver la société sur l'annuaire.
